# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.
te_pg_building_sum_academics = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_ranching is_building_group = bg_subsistence_ranching } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_ranching_mortality_mult } }

		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }

	}

		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.02 }

	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_logging }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.02 }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_military_industry }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_canals is_building_group = bg_private_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_public_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_trade } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_fishing }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.02 }
	}
}

		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_manufacturing is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry is_building_group = bg_light_industry is_building_group = bg_military_industry is_building_group = bg_ship_construction is_building_group = bg_construction } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_manufacturing_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_manufacturing_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}

		limit = { is_building_group = bg_military_industry }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_military_industry_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_military_industry_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_mining_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_mining_laborers_mortality_mult } }

	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_oil_extraction }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_oil_extraction_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_oil_extraction_laborers_mortality_mult } }

		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_ranching is_building_group = bg_subsistence_ranching } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_ranching_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_ranching_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_rubber_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_rubber_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_service }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_service_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_whaling }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_whaling_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_whaling_laborers_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_logging }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_oil_extraction }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_light_industry is_building_group = bg_ship_construction } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry is_building_group = bg_construction } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_military_industry }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_canals is_building_group = bg_private_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_public_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_trade } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_whaling }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_fishing }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.05 }
	}
}

		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_mining_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_oil_extraction }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_oil_extraction_mortality_mult } }

	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_ranching is_building_group = bg_subsistence_ranching } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_ranching_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_rubber_mortality_mult } }

	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_service }

		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_whaling_mortality_mult } }
	}
}

# THIS = a building, a slaves pop's workplace: its groups' group-wide and slaves mortality reads into
# te_pg_bsum, and the working_conditions table's value into te_pg_btab.
te_pg_building_sum_slaves = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_agriculture is_building_group = bg_staple_crops is_building_group = bg_subsistence_agriculture } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_agriculture_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_fishing }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_fishing_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_government is_building_group = bg_bureaucracy is_building_group = bg_monuments is_building_group = bg_skyscraper is_building_group = bg_technology } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_government_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry is_building_group = bg_construction } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_heavy_industry_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_canals is_building_group = bg_private_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_public_infrastructure is_building_group = bg_trade } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_infrastructure_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_logging }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_logging_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_logging_slaves_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_manufacturing is_building_group = bg_heavy_industry is_building_group = bg_light_industry is_building_group = bg_military_industry is_building_group = bg_ship_construction is_building_group = bg_construction } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_manufacturing_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_military_industry }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_military_industry_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_mining_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_mining_slaves_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_oil_extraction }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_oil_extraction_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_plantations_slaves_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { is_building_group = bg_ranching is_building_group = bg_subsistence_ranching } }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_ranching_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_rubber_mortality_mult add = modifier:building_group_bg_rubber_slaves_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_service }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_service_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_whaling }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_bsum add = { value = modifier:building_group_bg_whaling_mortality_mult } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_mining }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_plantations }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_rubber }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_logging }
		change_local_variable = { name = te_pg_btab add = 0.2 }
	}
}
